description: The derived controls (D57) with no offsets. Root (0,0,0), mid (1.8,2.4,0), end (5,0,0): bones 3 and 4, so the limb is 7 long. The handle sits on the end joint (5,0,0). The mid is 2.4 above the root-to-end line (+X), so the bend is +Y and the pole is mid + 7 * (0,1,0) = (1.8, 9.4, 0). The settings control is the end plus a quarter of the length along world X: (6.75, 0, 0).
